# @skene/design-system

Tokens, a Tailwind v4 theme, 89 React components, and machine-readable
contracts that tell an agent which component to reach for before it writes a
new one. Published restricted; public to read, not open source.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): install, configure, use, and the read order for the contracts below.

## Contracts (YAML, shipped inside the package)

- [machine/context.yaml](/machine/context.yaml): which module to reach for, and what else each covers. 89 modules. Read first.
- [machine/components.yaml](/machine/components.yaml): what you must not do with a given component.
- [machine/rules.yaml](/machine/rules.yaml): the reach ladder, the must_not list, ask_first_when.
- [machine/compositions.yaml](/machine/compositions.yaml): how whole pages are assembled — section order per page archetype, derived from pages that were built.
- [machine/tokens.yaml](/machine/tokens.yaml): the token vocabulary and which role belongs on which surface.
- [machine/layouts.yaml](/machine/layouts.yaml): spacing and radius scales, breakpoints, widths; plus the dashboard templates, marked as not shipped here yet.
- [machine/accessibility.yaml](/machine/accessibility.yaml): a11y contracts, including contrast floors.

## Skills (Agent Skills, shipped inside the package)

- [skills/skene-design-system-setup/SKILL.md](/skills/skene-design-system-setup/SKILL.md): first-time install, the stylesheet, the Tailwind @source line and the proof it took.
- [skills/skene-design-system/SKILL.md](/skills/skene-design-system/SKILL.md): picking a component before writing one, the intent index, and the fields that bite.
- [skills/skene-design-system-pages/SKILL.md](/skills/skene-design-system-pages/SKILL.md): composing a whole page — the spine, the eight archetypes and their confidence.

## Prose

- [docs/sections.md](/docs/sections.md): decision paths, and every measured overlap with a verdict.
- [docs/brand.md](/docs/brand.md): voice and brand.
- [docs/principles.md](/docs/principles.md): the design principles.
- [docs/ux-patterns.md](/docs/ux-patterns.md): interaction patterns.
- [README.md](/README.md): the human entry point.

## Data

- [design-tokens.json](/design-tokens.json): 331 token values, the source the CSS and TS are generated from.
